system.description:
• Untitled, unaffiliated, and unsponsored knights — some trained by true knights and left without a lord, others self-made through pure combat experience. No keep, no banner, no backing. Just the code they chose for themselves.
  • Steadfast Courage: your Embolden replaces the usual one. Once per day, companions and followers within 60ft gain +2 to Fortitude and Reflex saves and +3 to Will saves, for rounds equal to twice your Knight level. It cannot combine with Inspire or Demoralise.
  • Common Ground: Advantage on Charisma checks when dealing with common folk, mercenaries, or anyone who distrusts titled nobility.
